newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU concerned at Russian border tax plans.
newsitem.headline: EU concerned at Russian border tax plans.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was extremely concerned about Russian plans to impose border taxes on all people entering or leaving its territory.

"(European Commissioner Hans) van den Broek is extremely concerned about this new measure which clearly is not in keeping with the spirit of (the EU's) interim agreement with Russia," European Commission spokesman Nico Wegter told a news briefing.
Wegter said Russian authorities had decided to introduce a border tax of $10 on all people entering or leaving Russia and a tax of $180 on all lorry border crossings.
He said that according to Commission information the tax would also apply at airports.

Wegter said the Commission would take "diplomatic initiatives" to assess the planned tax which he said called into question EU aid already earmarked for Russia to improve border crossings with EU member Finland.
Wegter added that EU worries about threatened Russian quotas on textiles and vodka remained unresolved.
